shapes.rules: One or two representative inputs. Assert the exact return value, never its type or its count.
Empty input, one element, and the value either side of each limit. One test per boundary, exact values.
The inputs the contract rejects. Assert that it throws, the error type, and that the message names the offending value.

functions.name: percentChange
functions.signature: Numbers.percentChange(from: Double, to: Double) throws -> Double
functions.notes: Throws RangeError when `from` is 0. The denominator is |from|, so a rise from -10 to -5 is +0.5.

functions.name: mean
functions.notes: An empty list has a mean of 0, which is a decision rather than a mathematical fact.

functions.name: median
functions.notes: Sorts a copy — the input is never reordered. An even count gives the mean of the middle two; empty gives 0.
